pages.text: In the years when the Gemstone Malignasaur ravaged the seas, this terrifying whirlpool and its raging water bolts tore countless merchant ships apart; today that dreadful whirlpool is so weak that even you can master it with ease - no offence meant.

pages.title: Whirlpool Focus
pages.text: 20 souls, 1 second of wind-up, 4 second cooldown. One whirlpool per spell level, 10 degrees apart; a Abyss Staff adds one level. Anything holding Water Breathing or Conduit Power takes only a third of the damage.
